name: Production RAG Application
description: Ask policy questions with hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking and exact-source citations.
detail: Evidence first. No unsupported freeform answers.

name: Local SLM App with Ollama
description: Run private local inference and compare three models on the same machine with measured speed and quality.
detail: Offline inference when weights and services are local.

name: Monitoring & Observability
description: Inspect request traces, p50/p95 latency, estimated cost and evaluation regression gates.
detail: No prompt or document content stored in traces.

name: Fine-Tuning with LoRA & DPO
description: Train JSON extraction adapters and compare actual base, SFT and DPO results on matched held-out data.
detail: No invented improvement metrics. Train on a separate worker.

name: Real-Time Multimodal Application
description: Ask with voice or text, follow streamed progress and hear validated answers with offline speech output.
detail: Bounded queues, timeouts and graceful text fallback.
